# heatmap_publication.R

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)    
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

# Dados

```{r}
ret <- data.frame(
  Motif = factor(c("Mono-","Di-","Tri-","Tetra-","Penta-",
                   "Hexa-","Hepta-","Octa-","Nona-"),
                 levels = rev(c("Mono-","Di-","Tri-","Tetra-","Penta-",
                                "Hexa-","Hepta-","Octa-","Nona-"))),
  D1_D2 = c(61.5,84.8,90.9,89.4,93.6,92.5,93.0,90.0,83.2),
  D2_D3 = c(0.44,0.90,7.79,9.90,18.1,19.2,17.0,22.8,26.7),
  D1_D3 = c(0.27,0.77,7.08,8.85,16.9,17.8,15.8,20.5,22.2)
)
```

# Formato longo com tidyverse

```{r}
ret_long <- ret %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("D"),
               names_to = "Comparison",
               values_to = "Retention") %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = recode(Comparison,
                        D1_D2 = "Discovery → Genotyping",
                        D2_D3 = "Genotyping → Filtered",
                        D1_D3 = "Discovery → Filtered"),
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("Discovery → Genotyping",
                                              "Genotyping → Filtered",
                                              "Discovery → Filtered"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Retention),
    label_col = ifelse(Retention > 50, "black", "white")
  )
```

# Plot refinado

```{r}
p <- ggplot(ret_long, aes(x = Comparison, y = Motif, fill = Retention)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.92, height = 0.92, color = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = label_col),
            size = 3.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    direction = 1,          # agora cores quentes representam valores mais altos
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    name = "Retention (%)"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Motif type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 12, b = 6, l = 6)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    barwidth = 0.6, barheight = 6,
    ticks = TRUE, ticks.colour = "black"
  ))

print(p)
```

# Salvar em alta resolução (raster) e em vetor

```{r}
ggsave("heatmap_retention_600dpi.png", p, width = 6.5, height = 4.0, dpi = 600)
```
